name: Laguna 69
why: The Cordillera Blanca's famous blue lake under Chacraraju's glacier, past waterfalls and the Llanganuco lakes on the way.
book: Huascarán National Park ticket (day or multi-day) at the Llanganuco gate. Tours from Huaraz at 05:00.
dangers: From 3,900 to 4,600 m: acclimatise first with Laguna Churup.
The last climb comes after 3 hours of walking: keep energy for it.
turnaround: Tour groups turn back at a fixed time (usually 13:00): if you are not at the lake by then, turn back too.

points.name: Cebollapampa meadow
points.note: The trailhead at 3,900 m on the Llanganuco road, past the turquoise Llanganuco lakes: cows, a river and Chacraraju ahead.

points.name: Laguna 69 waterfalls
points.note: The zigzags beside the waterfalls, 4,100-4,380 m; above them a flat meadow with a small lake.

points.name: Laguna 69
points.note: About 4,600 m, under the Chacraraju glacier.
